parameters.name: CallBack
parameters.description: The callback URL for job results. Only HTTP URLs are supported.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description: The OSS address of the input file for trace watermark extraction.

parameters.name: Params
parameters.description:
Parameters for the extraction job, specified as a JSON string. The following parameter is supported:

- m3u8Type: The algorithm type. Default: v1.

  - v1: Extracts an M3U8 file with an absolute path.

  - v2: Extracts an M3U8 file with a relative path.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: A publicly accessible URL of the video file. If specified, this URL is used as the job input and takes precedence over the Input parameter.
